title: FERC General Correspondence — Docket P-8405-000: Letter to Green Mountain Power Corporation, regarding the 08/20/2026 Dam Safety Inspection of the Glen Road Dam Project under P-8405.
text:
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION
Office of Energy Projects
Division of Dam Safety and Inspections – New York Regional Office
Telephone No. (212) 273-5900
September 1, 2026
VIA Electronic Mail
Jonathan Findon-Henry, P.E.,
Chief Dam Safety Engineer
Green Mountain Power Corporation
jonathan.findon@greenmountainpower.com
RE: Letter to Green Mountain Power Corporation, regarding the August 20, 2026 Dam Safety
Inspection of the Glen Road Dam under P-8405.
Dear Mr. Henry:
My staff conducted a dam safety inspection at the above-referenced project. The assistance
provided by your staff during the inspection was greatly appreciated. Based on our visual
inspection, we have no comments at this time. The status of the annual submittals are
shown in the enclosed attachment.
At a later date, we may provide you with any additional comments that arise through our
inspection report preparation. For any questions regarding this letter, please contact Dr.
Thoma Beno by email at Thoma.Beno@ferc.gov.
Sincerely,
John Spain, P.E.
Regional Engineer
Enclosure: Attachment – Status of Annual Submissions

P-8405-NH, Glen Road Dam 2
Attachment
Annual Status Update Part 12D Recommendations
An independent consultant’s safety inspection report is not required since Glen Road Dam
and related impounding structures do not meet the height, storage or hazard potential
criteria outlined in Part 12, Subpart D of the Commission’s regulations.
Emergency Action Plan Requirements
By letter dated December 31, 2025, you filed the annual status report. The report satisfies
Section 6-2.2.6 of our Engineering Guidelines.
By letter dated February 8, 2024, you provided a complete reprint of the EAP. We find it
conforms to Chapter 6 of our engineering guidelines.
By letter dated February 26, 2026, you provided an updated EAP. We find it conforms to
Chapter 6 of our engineering guidelines.
Dam Safety Performance Monitoring Program
By letter dated March 31, 2026, you submitted the 2025 Dam Safety Surveillance and
Monitoring Report (DSSMR) and an updated Dam Safety Surveillance and Monitoring
Program (DSSMP) for the subject project. We have reviewed your submittal and found that
the 2025 DSSMR and the updated DSSMP conform to the outline and requirements
specified in Chapter 14 of the FERC Engineering Guidelines and are acceptable.
Public Safety Plan
A revised Public Safety Plan (PSP) was submitted by letter dated April 8, 2025, which was
accepted by D2SI-NYRO letter dated September 11, 2025.
Annual Gate Certification
The last annual gate test certification was submitted by letter dated March 31, 2026. The
last full gate test was conducted in October 2024. No issues are noted with the annual gate
test certification.
